turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How early should I actually turn up to an interview?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Aim to be in the building about ten minutes before. Earlier than that can put pressure on the interviewer.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Really? I thought earlier was always better.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Getting to the area early is great. Just wait in a cafe nearby rather than in their reception for half an hour.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Leave enough buffer for one delay, and save the recruiter's number in your phone so you can call if something goes wrong.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: there like forty minutes early and then wander around.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Perfect. Use that time for a quick look over your notes and a glass of water.
